- Added a link to public.com/signup in the description for account creation.
- Updated tags in metadata for improved discoverability.
- Added a disclaimer noting the skill is for informational purposes only and not investment advice.
- Removed legacy documentation files (README.md, requirements.txt) to streamline the repository.

Initial release of the Public.com skill:

- Enables users to interact with their Public.com brokerage account via API.
- Supports viewing portfolios, getting stock and crypto quotes, placing trades, and receiving account updates.
- Includes commands for viewing accounts, orders, available instruments, option expirations, option greeks, and option chains.
- Guides users through required configuration (API secret and optional account ID).
- Provides example commands and user request phrasing for each feature.
